mapper.sql: select 'ISUP' protocol_type, cast(id as char) device_key, trim(device_id) logical_device_id from isup_device where device_id is not null and trim(device_id) != '' union all select 'EHOME', cast(id as char), trim(device_id) from ehome_device union all select 'RTSP', cast(id as char), coalesce(nullif(trim(stream_id), ''), cast(id as char)) from rtsp_device union all select 'ONVIF', cast(id as char), coalesce(nullif(trim(stream_id), ''), cast(id as char)) from onvif_device union all select 'GB28181', cast(id as char), trim(device_id) from wvp_device where device_id is not null and trim(device_id) != '' union all select 'DAHUA', cast(id as char), trim(device_id) from dahua_device where device_id is not null and trim(device_id) != '' union all select 'VLSTREAM', cast(id as char), trim(device_id) from wvp_vlstream_device where device_id is not null and trim(device_id) != '' and (tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (tenant_id is null and #{tenantId}=#{defaultTenantId})) union all select 'CUSTOM', cast(id as char), trim(device_code) from wvp_custom_device where device_code is not null and trim(device_code) != ''
mapper.select: select * from wvp_device_category where category_type = #{categoryType} order by sort_num, id
mapper.insert: insert into wvp_device_category(category_type, parent_id, ancestors, category_name, sort_num, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{categoryType}, #{parentId}, #{ancestors}, #{categoryName}, #{sortNum}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update wvp_device_category set parent_id=#{parentId}, ancestors=#{ancestors}, category_name=#{categoryName}, sort_num=#{sortNum}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=now() where id=#{id}
update wvp_device_category set ancestors = concat(#{newPrefix}, substring(ancestors, length(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)), update_time=now() where find_in_set(#{categoryId}, ancestors)
mapper.select: select count(1) from wvp_device_category where parent_id=#{id}
select count(1) from wvp_device_category_relation where category_id=#{categoryId}

select category_id, category_type, protocol_type, device_key, create_by from wvp_device_category_relation where protocol_type=#{protocolType} and category_type=#{categoryType}
and device_key in (select cast(id as char) from wvp_vlstream_device where tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (tenant_id is null and #{tenantId}=#{defaultTenantId}))

select r.category_id, r.category_type, r.protocol_type, d.logical_device_id as device_key, r.create_by from wvp_device_category_relation r inner join () d on d.protocol_type = r.protocol_type and d.device_key = r.device_key where r.category_type = #{categoryType}

select distinct d.logical_device_id from wvp_device_category_relation r inner join wvp_device_category c on c.id = r.category_id inner join () d on d.protocol_type = r.protocol_type and d.device_key = r.device_key where r.category_type = #{categoryType} and (c.id = #{categoryId} or find_in_set(#{categoryId}, c.ancestors)) order by d.logical_device_id
select category_id, category_type, protocol_type, device_key, create_by from wvp_device_category_relation where protocol_type=#{protocolType} and device_key=#{deviceKey}
mapper.delete: delete from wvp_device_category_relation where protocol_type=#{protocolType} and device_key=#{deviceKey} and category_type=#{categoryType}
mapper.insert: insert into wvp_device_category_relation(category_id, category_type, protocol_type, device_key, create_by, create_time) values(#{categoryId}, #{categoryType}, #{protocolType}, #{deviceKey}, #{createBy}, now())

choose.when: select count(1) from wvp_vlstream_device where tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (tenant_id is null and #{tenantId}=#{defaultTenantId})

mapper.select: select count(1) from wvp_vlstream_device where cast(id as char)=#{deviceKey} and (tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (tenant_id is null and #{tenantId}=#{defaultTenantId}))
